output.scope_note: The paper studies Li+ dynamics in the oxide solid electrolyte La2/3-xLi3xTiO3 (x=0.13) and reports conductivity values, both QENS-derived in this work and a literature value.

records.synthesis_method: directional solidification (single crystal); solid-state reaction for powder
records.evidence_quote: The spatial average of the σQENS 0.055 ± 0.005 S/cm agrees with that of σLi ∼ 0.1 S/cm at T = 600 K reported from bulk conductivity measurements
records.notes: Conductivity is not measured directly; it is calculated from QENS self-diffusion via the Nernst-Einstein equation (sigma_QENS). Spatial average of in-plane and out-of-plane values.

records.notes: In-plane ([110]) direction value, calculated via Nernst-Einstein from QENS diffusion rather than measured directly.
